families.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

members.gloss: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
members.tone: The family's plain statement of the fault - order, methodical arrangement and working function all simply absent, with none of the wreckage *chaotic* pictures.

members.gloss: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
members.tone: Carries exactly the force of *disorganized*; the spelling is the whole of the difference.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
members.tone: Of a thing thrown into disarray rather than snapped in two - the confusion reads as damage done to it, not merely order gone missing.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
members.tone: Puts the muddle in the thing itself rather than in anyone's head - it is the arrangement that is tangled, not a mind.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
members.tone: Names the loss of order as a state the thing has been put into and leaves it there, without the damage *broken* implies or the fresh upheaval *upset* pictures.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
members.tone: Pictures the disarray as a tipping-over: the arrangement knocked out of place rather than destroyed, and the upheaval still fresh.

members.gloss: lacking a visible order or organization
members.tone: Sharpens the charge into a spectacle - not a trace of order or organization to be seen, where *disorganized* merely notes the lack.

members.gloss: lacking a visible order or organization
members.tone: Its jingling shape makes the same invisible order sound hectic and headlong, far lighter in judgement than *chaotic*.

members.gloss: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
members.tone: Coarse and total - a snarl or dead stop treated as a botch someone is answerable for, the harshest word in the family.

members.gloss: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
members.tone: Names the same total snarl-up or standstill with a clipped, almost breezy label - rueful where *fucked-up* is furious.

members.gloss: thrown together in a disorderly fashion
members.tone: Faults the making rather than the thing: pieces flung together in haste, so the disorder sits in how it was put together.

members.gloss: not efficient or methodical
members.tone: The coolest reproach here - it faults the missing method and the inefficiency that comes with it, and pictures no wreckage at all.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
members.tone: Pictures the collapse as a coming-apart - what was holding gives way, and the disorganization or incoherence follows from that.

members.gloss: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
members.tone: Sounds the same collapse as an unmaking, graver and more final than *unstuck* - the thing not merely loosened but ruined.

families.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

members.gloss: inspired by love for your country
members.tone: The plain approving word for love of country, holding the feeling at a warmth that *jingoistic* has already burned past.

members.gloss: inspired by love for your country
members.tone: Casts the same love as steadfast attachment rather than ardour, quieter and less demonstrative than *patriotic*.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: Condemning: the country's superiority held as an article of faith, all conviction and no judgement.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: Mocks the display rather than the belief, reducing the fanaticism to noisy show where *chauvinistic* attacks the conviction behind it.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: The sharpest edge in the group, hearing the fanaticism as belligerence rather than mere excess of zeal.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: The coolest-sounding of the fanatical set, naming the excess as a doctrine where *flag-waving* names its noise.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: Pushed past *nationalistic* to an extremity that leaves no reading in which the word admires what it describes.

members.gloss: fanatically patriotic
members.tone: Sarcastic: patriotism inflated past the point of belief, so the swelling itself is the accusation.

families.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

members.gloss: (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
members.tone: Flat and unloaded, and it holds both readings at once — a long life lived or simply a stated age attained — where *of age* carries only the second.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: Formal and weighty where *older* is merely comparative, presenting advanced years as a settled condition rather than a point on a scale.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: The courteous way to say advanced in years, gentler in force than *aged* and careful to claim nothing further about the person.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: A comparative doing the work of a plain description, which is what makes it the softest term here — it implies a scale instead of naming a state.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: Carries a note of standing rather than decline, making it the one flattering way in this set to say advanced in years.

members.gloss: having attained a specific age; (‘aged’ is pronounced as one syllable)
members.tone: Purely a threshold reached, with none of the weight of accumulated years that *aged* brings with it.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: Puts age in motion rather than in place - the process, not the state - and that forward motion carries its faint edge of decline.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: The British spelling of the same word, carrying the identical sense of decline already under way.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: Clinical and detached: it states the same growing old as *aging* in a register that declines to feel anything about it.

members.gloss: very old
members.tone: Pure intensification — *old* taken to its limit, and the size of the exaggeration is what gives it its edge.

members.gloss: of or like a feeble old woman
members.tone: Formal in shape but withering in effect, covering both actually being a feeble old woman and merely resembling one, with the contempt built into the word rather than the sentence.

members.gloss: being at least 100 years old
members.tone: Purely quantitative — it fixes a number where *ancient* only gestures at extremity, and passes no verdict with it.

members.gloss: (of fabrics and paper) grown dark in color over time
members.tone: The one member describing what time does to the colour of a material rather than to a life, and it carries no judgement at all.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: Contemptuous where *aged* is not, making the infirmity — of mind or of body — the whole of what it says about the person.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: The same verdict of age-borne infirmity as *doddering*, its shorter form making the mockery sound offhand rather than deliberate.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: Informal and blunt — the same infirmity as *doddering*, named in a word too flippant to leave the person any dignity.

families.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

members.gloss: careful and diligent in the use of resources
members.tone: Approving outright - care with resources treated as a settled virtue, where *penny-wise* grants that same care in miniature.

members.gloss: avoiding waste
members.tone: The cool one of the waste-avoiders — credits efficiency without implying any self-denial, which is what *frugal* adds.

members.gloss: avoiding waste
members.tone: The same waste-avoidance as *economical*, but worn as a discipline rather than run as an efficiency.

members.gloss: avoiding waste
members.tone: Barbed — the identical waste-avoidance of *economical* recast as an accusation of tightness.

members.gloss: avoiding waste
members.tone: Neutral — names the holding back itself and leaves it unjudged, where *thrifty* has already decided the holding back is good.

members.gloss: avoiding waste
members.tone: Tips into fault — the restraint reads as giving less than is due, where *sparing* keeps the same restraint blameless.

members.gloss: thrifty in small matters only
members.tone: Faint mockery — grants real thrift but confines it to small sums, so the praise arrives already qualified.

members.gloss: characterized by thriftiness
members.tone: The flat attributive — ascribes thriftiness as a standing trait without pressing the approval *thrifty* carries.

families.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

members.gloss: having or showing or indicative of high or elevated character
members.tone: The family's base term for the thing itself: it takes in character that is high, character that shows it, and anything that merely points to it.

members.gloss: investing with dignity or honor
members.tone: Names what confers standing rather than what holds it - the honour is being handed over, where *noble* already has it.

members.gloss: investing with dignity or honor
members.tone: More lift than *dignifying*: it raises what it touches rather than only decorating it with honour.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Reverent praise - it speaks of the height as though awe were owed to it, where *elevated* just records the same height.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: The measured word for that height, stating the value with no lift in the voice at all.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: The furthest reach here - elevation that overwhelms rather than merely impresses, beside which *grand* is only large.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Praises the sheer scale of the elevation where *exalted* praises its worth, so it impresses more than it moves.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: The most emphatic in manner - elevation pitched loudly enough to be heard, where *elevated* keeps its voice level.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Sober, earnest approval: it admires the height without supplying any of the grandeur *grand* does.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Height with distance in it - approving, but it sets the thing above the ordinary rather than among it.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Praise with thin air in it: the elevation is so far up that it reads as select rather than shared.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: The same select, thin-aired elevation as *rarefied*, spelled the other way.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: The least awed of these - it credits the pitch of the standard rather than any grandeur in the thing.

members.gloss: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
members.tone: Puts *noble* in plainer and more personal terms, naming high character straight out without the ceremony *exalted* carries.

members.gloss: noble and generous in spirit
members.tone: The warm end of the family - nobility felt as open generosity, and plain-spoken where *magnanimous* is formal.

members.gloss: noble and generous in spirit
members.tone: The formal, weighty word for that same generous nobility, stated as a virtue rather than felt as warmth.

families.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

members.gloss: marked by extreme lack of restraint or control
members.tone: Names the extremity of the missing restraint without colouring it, and tips negative only because the gloss calls the lack extreme rather than partial.

members.gloss: completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing
members.tone: Faults the state for what it does to anyone trying to follow it — unordered, unpredictable and confusing at once, where *wild* only says the reins are off.

members.gloss: completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing
members.tone: Carries the same absence of order as *chaotic* but frames it as an order failed rather than an order never present.

members.gloss: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
members.tone: Pitches the uncontrolled feeling high enough to suggest the senses have gone with it, which *excited* never implies.

members.gloss: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
members.tone: The unloaded member: it records the uncontrolled excitement and leaves the verdict to whoever is listening.

members.gloss: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
members.tone: Adds hurry and distress to the same uncontrolled feeling, so the energy reads as flailing rather than pleasure.

members.gloss: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
members.tone: Blunt and dismissive — it calls the uncontrolled emotion unreason outright instead of merely hinting at it as *delirious* does.

members.gloss: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
members.tone: The coolest word here, naming the control that is missing rather than picturing the emotion that fills the gap.

members.gloss: affected with or marked by frenzy or mania uncontrolled by reason
members.tone: Reason is overrun rather than loosened, and the word fits both the person seized by the frenzy and the scene that shows it.

members.gloss: affected with or marked by frenzy or mania uncontrolled by reason
members.tone: Gives the same reasonless frenzy a clinical ring, where *frenzied* stays pure motion.

members.gloss: not brought under control
members.tone: A flat negative that says only that control was never imposed, so it can read as endurance as easily as excess.

families.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

members.gloss: offensive to good taste especially in sexual matters
members.tone: The family's flat verdict of offence to good taste, sexual matters foremost though not only those, condemning without the flagrancy *crude* insists on.

members.gloss: conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
members.tone: Blunt and graceless force: the indecency is out in the open with no refinement over it, where *indecent* only names the offence.

members.gloss: conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
members.tone: The mildest-sounding word for the same conspicuous, tasteless indecency, its plainness softening what *gross* spits out.

members.gloss: conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
members.tone: Registers revulsion rather than disapproval, the indecency coarse enough to sicken, and the word is the flinch.

members.gloss: conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
members.tone: Passes judgement on the sensibility behind the indecency as much as on the act, a verdict of cheapness that *earthy* declines to pass.

members.gloss: verging on the indecent
members.tone: The lightest reproof here, indecency approached but not arrived at, so it rebukes where *obscene* accuses.

members.gloss: designed to incite to indecency or lust
members.tone: The heaviest charge in the family: not merely offensive but built to incite indecency or lust, design rather than effect.

members.gloss: tending to suggest something improper or indecent
members.tone: Works by implication, pointing toward the improper or the indecent without stating it, and accuses more lightly than *crude* for that reason.

families.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

members.gloss: incapable of being tolerated or endured
members.tone: The flat verdict of the three - it rules the thing out rather than measuring what holding it costs, which is what *unbearable* does.

members.gloss: incapable of being tolerated or endured
members.tone: Puts the weight on whoever is carrying it, so the limit reached is a person's capacity rather than the judgement *intolerable* hands down.

members.gloss: incapable of being tolerated or endured
members.tone: The same limit measured in duration - what cannot be lasted out, where *unbearable* is what cannot be held up under.

members.gloss: very difficult to accept or bear
members.tone: The one member that concedes the thing can be accepted or borne, at a price the others say is past paying at all.

members.gloss: too extreme to bear
members.tone: Names the excess itself - the thing has gone past a limit, where *intolerable* simply refuses it without saying by how much.

members.gloss: too extreme to bear
members.tone: Says exactly what *insufferable* says, and the difference is flatness rather than degree.

members.gloss: (used of persons or their behavior) not acceptable or reasonable
members.tone: Exasperated rather than judicial - it writes a person or their conduct off as beyond dealing with, where *unacceptable* files a ruling.

members.gloss: (used of persons or their behavior) not acceptable or reasonable
members.tone: The cool, formal counterpart of *impossible*: it finds the person or the behaviour unreasonable without any of the heat.

members.gloss: not able to be supported or defended
members.tone: Shifts the fault from what cannot be borne to what cannot be defended, so the weakness is in the thing's own standing rather than in anyone's strain.
